literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) reports stable expression of full-length human IL-5Rα (residues 1–420) on the surface of TF-1 cells, used to evaluate anti-IL-5Rα antibody antagonism of IL-5-dependent proliferation. It describes a plain overexpression construct — no epitope tag, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon/domain-insertion screen, or antibody-epitope knock-in is mentioned anywhere in the clip. Because the ledger qualification rule requires an insertion actually tolerated, L1 does not ground any surface-tag site. The mature extracellular N-terminus begins at residue 21 (D) after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 20 (A), and the extracellular domain runs to residue 341 (E) before the TM helix (342–362); these landmarks are noted for completeness but cannot be used to propose a site without a qualifying ledger line.
